ValidationRule.description: No changes can be made to Activated/Executed comtract record. 9/22/23 Updating because Executed Contract were being updated, rule onnly triggered if in Activated Status before. 05/02/2025 Updated to exclude CPQ contracts
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', Price_Book_Name__c <> 'CPQ', OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Activated"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Executed") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can't change a Contract Record once it's been Activated. If the record is wrong please submit a ticket in Jira for your Salesforce Administrator and include the link to the Contract and changes needed.
